Version 1.0.5

- Added an alternative "quick QR code payment" option for users without a ClawTip account, including WeChat and Alipay QR codes.
- Updated payment instructions in SKILL.md to guide users through both ClawTip standard and QR scan payment flows.
- Removed the obsolete skill-card.md file.

- Added requirement to install and configure clawtip-skill before starting payment and authorization.
- Documentation now clearly warns users not to proceed with payment if clawtip-skill is missing or not functioning.
- No changes to features or workflow; update is documentation-only.

cross-platform-memory-hub 1.0.3

- Narrowed trigger phrases; now only responds to explicit commands (e.g., “记忆枢纽: 配置/写入/读取/复盘/状态”).
- Removed all default automatic memory reading and writing—actions now require explicit user authorization per session.
- Updated Claude Code Hook adapters to require manual environment variable confirmation and explicit user-provided summaries before any action.
- Enhanced security: no file system scanning, read, or write occurs unless authorized; user must confirm operations and content before execution.
- Documentation (README, SKILL.md, usage guides) revised to reflect stricter manual control and clarify setup/authorization.

cross-platform-memory-hub 1.0.2

- Enhanced explanation of data privacy, authorization, and local storage.
- Refined manual command list, storage/reading rules, and three-platform adaptation guidance.
- Expanded documentation of file/folder structure and user prompts throughout initialization.

Cross-Platform Memory Hub 1.0.1

- Introduced paid model with permanent license (¥1.90, ClawTip payment required).
- Added remote service use clarification: only for order, payment, and authorization verification.
- Updated setup instructions to include pre-use payment verification steps.
- Clearly specify no upload of Obsidian content; all data stays local.
- Enhanced privacy and security documentation.
